2610.13534.title: MAGMA-Bench: Evaluating Long-Horizon Embodied Agents under Dynamic Tasks and Execution Failures
2610.13534.paper_summary: Long-horizon embodied agents must maintain task-relevant information, coordinate heterogeneous robots, and adapt their decisions as execution unfolds. Existing benchmarks investigate dynamic task execution and embodied multi-agent coordination, but provide limited evaluation of their intersection. We introduce MAGMA-Bench, an architecture-agnostic benchmark for persistent task reasoning in dynamic multi-robot environments. MAGMA-Bench evaluates agents across increasing task horizons and controlled online perturbations, including execution failures, task interruptions, and mission updates, with scenarios requiring coordination across robots with heterogeneous capabilities. It uses a structured skill-level interface to separate task-level reasoning from perception and low-level control. We evaluate locally deployable open-weight planners, multi-agent state-tracking strategies, and frontier models. Even the strongest evaluated models fail on a substantial fraction of clean episodes, and their success rates decrease further under online perturbations. Supervised adaptation greatly improves a small model, but performance remains substantially lower on longer and multi-robot missions. We release the benchmark, 261,646 task-level training examples, and an architecture-agnostic expert-trace generation pipeline.
2610.13534.paper_summary_zh: 長期的具身代理必須維持與任務相關的信息，協調異質機器人，並隨著執行的展開調整其決策。現有的基準測試調查動態任務執行和具身多代理協調，但對其交集的評估有限。我們推出了MAGMA-Bench，一個架構無關的基準，用於在動態多機器人環境中進行持續任務推理。MAGMA-Bench評估代理在不斷增加的任務視野和受控的在線擾動下的表現，包括執行失敗、任務中斷和任務更新，場景要求在具異質能力的機器人之間進行協調。它使用結構化的技能級別介面將任務級推理與感知和低級控制分開。我們評估了本地可部署的開放權重規劃器、多代理狀態跟蹤策略和邊界模型。即使是評估過的最強模型在相當一部分乾淨的集數中仍然失敗，並且在在線擾動下其成功率進一步下降。監督適應大大改善了一個小模型，但在較長和多機器人任務上的表現仍然顯著較低。我們發布了基準、261,646個任務級訓練範例，以及一個架構無關的專家追蹤生成管道。
